OnlySwap app screens, as built

Captured 2026-10-09 from the Expo web build (apps/mobile, export:web) at iPhone size (393 x 852 pt, 2x), with every backend call answered by fake data for a fictional school, Demo University.

The web build browses Discover as a grid (W08), so the native swipe deck is not shown. Photos needed a small CSS fix at capture time because they render 0 px tall in the raw web build (see the last section).
